claims: The Artemis II mission successfully splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California, on April 10, 2026, at 8:07 p.m. ET.
The Orion capsule landed near San Diego to allow the U.S. Navy and NASA recovery teams to efficiently retrieve the crew.
The Artemis II mission's landing type was Pacific Ocean splashdown.
The Artemis II mission landed west of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II mission completed a 10-day moon flyby mission.
Artemis III is planned to land on the surface of the Moon near the lunar South Pole.
